name: AI Agent Linux
postStartCommand: bash -c 'cd /workspaces/my-agent && npm install && nohup node server.js > server.log 2>&1 & echo "Server started"'

postAttachCommand.server: bash -c 'cd /workspaces/my-agent && (pgrep -f "node server.js" > /dev/null || (nohup node server.js > server.log 2>&1 & echo "Server restarted")) && cat server.log | tail -20'
